rules.pattern: ^(xNVSE|JIP PP LN|JIP LN NVSE Plugin|ShowOff xNVSE Plugin|Fallout[: -] New Virtual Reality)$
rules.explanation: This component is part of the documented FNVR V2 prerequisite stack.
rules.suggested_action: Keep it enabled in the isolated VR profile and validate its exact version in preflight.

rules.explanation: HUD, dialogue, and Pip-Boy layout changes can be difficult to read or interact with in stereo VR.
rules.suggested_action: Retain the mod, test every relevant surface in-headset, and use a VR-specific patch when available.

rules.explanation: Camera/FOV overrides can fight FNVR aiming or VRClient's native head tracking.
rules.suggested_action: Test in isolation and disable only by explicit user choice if tracking or projection breaks.

rules.explanation: Animation, skeleton, inertia, and weapon-position mods can alter the transforms FNVR uses for hand aiming.
rules.suggested_action: Check weapon pose and shot direction with representative weapons; prefer an explicit compatibility patch.

rules.explanation: FNVR V2 upstream explicitly states that VATS is not supported by the motion-control mod.
rules.suggested_action: Keep the original non-VR profile for VATS play; in the isolated VR profile, choose a separately verified bullet-time alternative if desired. VRClient will not disable the mod automatically.

rules.explanation: Input, VATS, hotkey, and gesture mods can conflict with FNVR controller mappings; FNVR upstream states VATS is not supported.
rules.suggested_action: Use a bullet-time alternative only by user choice and validate every controller action.

rules.explanation: Graphics wrappers and post-processing can conflict with VRClient's native render hook, stereo submission, or comfort.
rules.suggested_action: Identify root DLL ownership and test without automatic deletion; prefer a VR-safe preset or patch.

rules.explanation: Unknown native plugins may be build-specific or hook the same engine surfaces as FNVR prerequisites.
rules.suggested_action: Verify its current xNVSE compatibility and inspect logs after launch.
